title: asterocephalus suaveolens
intro: Asterocephalus suaveolens, commonly known as the Starflower, is a plant species in the family Campanulaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Asterocephalus suaveolens include its antispasmodic and expectorant properties, which help to relieve respiratory spasms and promote the expulsion of mucus. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
